        in.close();
        
        int res = 0;
        if (s != null && s.length() > 0) {      
            for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ) {
                int j = i + 1;
                while (j < s.length() && s.charAt(j) == s.charAt(i)) {
                    j++;
                }
                int length = j - i;
                if (length % 2 == 0) {
                    res++;
                }
                i = j;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(res);
    }

}
